meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后,如果你用它检查 LazyCodex 或 Codex 命令行工具的安装情况,它会对照最新官方源码检查本地安装,找出过期、损坏或配置错误的地方,并输出一份带证据的通过/警告/失败报告。它只做检查,不会改动你的安装或配置。
howto.when: 当你提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等关键词,或要求做健康检查,或在安装/更新/更改配置后觉得 Codex 行为异常时。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 的安装是否正常
say.note: 会对照最新源码给出通过/警告/失败报告

say.text: 我的 Codex 更新后行为有点怪,帮我诊断一下
say.note: 会检查配置、插件和运行时,找出差异

say.text: 对比本地 LazyCodex 和最新代码,有没有过期或损坏
say.note: 会生成带证据的漂移检查结果

howto.what_en: After installation, it checks a LazyCodex or Codex CLI install against the latest sources, finds stale/broken/misconfigured parts, and outputs a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence. It only diagnoses; it never modifies your install or configuration.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or ask for a health check, or when Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex installation is healthy
say_en.note: Compares against latest sources and gives a PASS/WARN/FAIL report

say_en.text: My Codex acts oddly after an update; diagnose it
say_en.note: Inspects config, plugin payload, and runtime for drift

say_en.text: Compare my local LazyCodex with the latest code for drift
say_en.note: Produces an evidence-backed drift check result
